sloka: कच्चिन्न लोकायतिकान् ब्राह्मणांस्तात सेवसे ।अनर्थकुशला ह्येते बाला: पण्डितमानिन: ॥ २.१००.३९॥
transliteration: kaccinna lokāyatikān brāhmaṇāṁstāta sevase ।anarthakuśalā hyete bālā: paṇḍitamānina: ॥ 2.100.39॥

translations.english: While principal scriptures do exist, these superficial fellows take resort to the science of logic based on abstract reasoning, and indulge in futile talks.
